title: Tim Taylor says the president handed him the item at dinner

tellings.quote: And he said, "I was at the dinner table with the president and handed me that."

plain: A man named Timothy Taylor is said to have claimed that a president handed him a certain item while they sat at the dinner table together. Chris Bledsoe, a man whose reported UFO encounters have drawn interest from NASA, repeats what Taylor told him, quoting him as saying, "I was at the dinner table with the president and handed me that," though which item and which president are left unsaid.
